mapper.select:
select t1.*,t3.ORGNAME from TBL_CEA_PEOPLE_LEAVE t1 left join TBL_STAFF t2 on t1.staffId=t2.STAFFID left join TBL_ORGANIZATION t3 on t3.ORGID = t2.ORGID where not exists(select * from TBL_CEA_CANCEL_HOLIDAY t2 where t2.RELATIONID = t1.ID and t2.STATE = 6) and t1.STATE = 6
and t1.STAFFID = #{param.staffId}
and t2.REALNAME like concat('%',concat(#{param.staffName},'%'))
and t1.STAFFNUMBER like concat('%',concat(#{param.staffNumber},'%'))
and t3.ORGNAME like concat('%',concat(#{param.orgname},'%'))
and t1.ID in
#{item}
order by t1.ID desc
